messages:
sam: quick pass: ran the 90-day recurrence job and grouped incidents by root cause. high-level: deployment config drift (22%), autoscaler flaps (18%), registry/image pulls (14%), memory pressure on long-context (12%), KV cache regen storms (10%), other (24%). sheet with breakdown & links: https://redwood.company/ops/recurring-90d.

leila: awesome, can you paste the top 3 suggested short-term mitigations? we need things we can do within 10 business days.

sam: sure. short list: (A) pin rollout flags + add preflight check to CI (B) conservative autoscaler smoothing for ramp windows (C) fallback mirror + exponential backoff for registry pulls. also small notes on monitoring: add heatmap tile & alert for repeated incident fingerprints.

andrew: i'll take A (rollout flags). plan: add a CI preflight that checks for drift against last-known-good, and block merges if mismatched. ETA 7 days. AI-3001 | CI rollout preflight | andrew | 2026-04-05 | RED-6101

leila: i'll own C (registry fallback). will coordinate windows with registry and ops. ETA 9 days. AI-3002 | registry fallback + backoff | leila | 2026-04-07 | RED-6102

sam: i'll own B (autoscaler smoothing). will run a 2-week canary then roll. AI-3003 | autoscaler ramp smoothing | sam | 2026-04-12 | RED-6103

postmortem-bot: Note: created RED-6101, RED-6102, RED-6103 and attached to recurring-incidents epic RED-6200. Weekly progress check-in every Monday.

leila: on the memory pressure item: short-term mitigation options: per-plan input cap + route >8k token requests to dedicated long-context pool. medium-term: spill-to-host or quantized long-context variant.

andrew: adding monitoring suggestion for memory regressions. sample alert (prom):
```
avg_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job="inference",model=~".*long.*"}[15m]) / gpu_capacity_bytes > 0.75
```
Set for a 5m evaluation window to reduce noise.

sam: good. leila, can you add the alert link to the runbook? also add a dashboard heatmap tile (root_cause x week) - low priority but useful.

leila: will add both. ETA dashboard tile 2026-04-10. AI-3004 | add heatmap & runbook links | leila | 2026-04-10 | RED-6104

andrew: one pattern noticed: ~30% of deployment drift incidents were caused by missing owner in the postmortem. recommendation: change postmortem flow to require an explicit remediation owner + due date before closing. propose we require this policy starting Apr 15.

sam: +1. policy PR incoming. AI-3005 | postmortem template change (owner required) | sam | 2026-04-03 | RED-6105

ops-bot: Automated reminder: please ensure AIs include owner and due date. I will block closing any postmortem without that metadata starting 2026-04-15.

leila: scheduling note: 30-min sync next Thurs Apr 13 10:00 PT to triage any blockers. please add blockers to RED-6200 epic.

andrew: a couple of older AIs with no progress: RED-5999 (kv regen fix) and RED-6002 (image-pull observability). flagged them and tentatively re-assigned to oncall rotation. pinging @oncall to confirm.

sam: we should avoid reassigning to oncall by default. action: product-ops to own overdue remediations >30 days. I'll update the tracker. AI-3006 | overdue remediation policy | sam | 2026-04-08 | RED-6106

postmortem-bot: Weekly status will include: count of recurring incidents, open AIs, overdue AIs, and heatmap link. Posting every Monday 09:00 PT in #incidents.

leila: thanks all. summary: AI-3001..3006 created; owners assigned; schedule set. I'll drive registry work and dashboard pieces. reopening if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

andrew: thanks. let's try to close the short-term AIs within the 10-day window.

sam: closing note: i'll publish the 90-day heatmap to the ops dashboard and link it in the weekly post. reconvene Apr 13 for sync. :calendar:
